notes.title: New patch has just landed!
notes.notes:
Hello you wastelanders!

Reporting in: a new patch has arrived! 

We've added Korean localization and patched in a windowed mode. Also, we've gotten rid of some common crash reasons. 

We're very thankful for your support of the game and all the positive reviews you've left us. 
Please, do spread the word about the game if you like it - this really helps us out!

Thanks for sticking with us!

Team Demagog and Untold Tales

notes.title: Golf Club: Wasteland release date announced
notes.notes:
Well hello all you Martians out there.

Exciting news. We have a release date! 

Friday, September 3rd, 2021.

So wipe down that 9 iron and put on a hazmat suit, we're going golfing in the radioactive remains of humanity!

From our side, we've pretty much wrapped up with development and are now doing the final polishing and also making sure our console versions are nice and shiny.

So check out the new trailer that's choke-full of unseen gameplay, share it with all your filthy-rich friends who we're making fun of in the game and make sure to hit that wishlist button if you haven't already.

[previewyoutube=kLP8obS7C0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks!

Team Demagog and Untold Tales

P.S. Ignore that we said it was going to be out sometime in August. Shipping games on time is hard ok.
